Theorem
[Limits based in $\Sigma $ are nonflat shrinkers] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0180 ↗ thm:chow-iv-type-i-singular-point-sets-equal ↗ thm:chow-iv-type-i-singular-point-limits-nonflat 1. ch30:30.27\group Type I Singularity Models

Let $p\in \Sigma $ for a Type I singular solution on a closed manifold. For any $t_i\nearrow \omega $, the curvature-scale rescalings \[ \widehat g_i(t)=|\Rm |(p,t_i) g\bigl(t_i+|\Rm |(p,t_i)^{-1}t\bigr) \] subconverge to a non-Ricci-flat shrinking gradient Ricci soliton.
